prompt.zh: 只看视觉描述，你更想把哪一种用于笔记封面？
prompt.en: From the visual descriptions alone, which would you prefer for a notebook cover?

label.zh: 暖米色纸面上点缀小花与织纹。
label.en: Warm cream paper with small flowers and a woven texture.

label.zh: 深棕底色配旧书页与细线边框。
label.en: Deep brown with old-paper motifs and a fine border.

label.zh: 浅灰底色、一条直线和大片留白。
label.en: Light grey with one straight line and generous empty space.

label.zh: 雾蓝与乳白条纹，边缘像轻薄布料。
label.en: Misty blue and cream stripes with a light fabric-like edge.

prompt.zh: 为一个小角落选视觉基调，你更喜欢？
prompt.en: Which visual direction would you prefer for a small corner?

label.zh: 暗木色、书脊排列与低饱和深绿。
label.en: Dark wood tones, rows of book spines and muted deep green.

label.zh: 少量同色物件与清楚的几何轮廓。
label.en: A few tonal objects with clear geometric outlines.

label.zh: 浅木色、宽松布面与柔和蓝白。
label.en: Pale wood, relaxed fabric and soft blue-white tones.

label.zh: 苔色、小斑点和不规则的自然纹样。
label.en: Moss tones, small speckles and irregular natural motifs.

prompt.zh: 假设这些只是纸面配色，不涉及购买，你更喜欢哪组？
prompt.en: If these are only colours on paper, with no purchase involved, which set appeals most?

label.zh: 乳白、石灰与少量黑色直线。
label.en: Cream, stone grey and a few black lines.

label.zh: 沙米、浅蓝与温和的白。
label.en: Sand beige, pale blue and a soft white.

label.zh: 苔绿、土褐与零星锈色。
label.en: Moss green, earth brown and scattered rust tones.

label.zh: 深炭色、亮青与局部紫光。
label.en: Dark charcoal, bright cyan and a localised violet glow.

prompt.zh: 一张完全自编的图案纸，你更愿意用哪种描述？
prompt.en: Which description would you choose for an independently designed pattern sheet?

label.zh: 疏朗条纹与舒展的浅色布纹。
label.en: Open stripes and relaxed light fabric textures.

label.zh: 叶脉、蘑菇轮廓与零散的小圆点。
label.en: Leaf veins, mushroom outlines and scattered small dots.

label.zh: 交错网格、发光细线与机械接口形状。
label.en: Crossing grids, luminous lines and mechanical connector shapes.

label.zh: 细小花枝、格纹与柔和手作边缘。
label.en: Small flowering sprigs, checks and soft handmade edges.

prompt.zh: 在文字描绘的画面里，你更想多看哪一个？
prompt.en: Which word-described scene would you most want to look at longer?

label.zh: 近距离观察带斑点的叶面和粗糙树皮。
label.en: A close view of speckled leaves and rough bark.

label.zh: 暗色城市立面里嵌着明亮线条和屏幕形状。
label.en: A dark urban surface inset with bright lines and screen-like forms.

label.zh: 暖色小窗、花纹布料和圆润陶器。
label.en: A warm small window, patterned fabric and rounded pottery.

label.zh: 深色书架、旧纸边与对称拱形。
label.en: Dark shelves, aged paper edges and symmetrical arches.

prompt.zh: 给一张自己写的短卡片选边框，你偏向？
prompt.en: Which border would you prefer around a short card you wrote?

label.zh: 带局部亮色的断线与技术网格。
label.en: Broken lines and technical grids with a bright accent.

label.zh: 细花枝与略带手工感的重复图案。
label.en: Small flowering branches and slightly handmade repeats.

label.zh: 深色细框、窄边和旧纸般底色。
label.en: A dark fine frame, narrow margins and old-paper tones.

label.zh: 简洁直线与均匀的空白边缘。
label.en: Simple straight lines and even blank margins.

prompt.zh: 不改变空间功能，只换一张自己做的桌面图，你更想选？
prompt.en: Without changing a space’s function, which self-made desktop image would you choose?

label.zh: 暖木纹与少量花草图形。
label.en: Warm wood grain with a few flower and plant shapes.

label.zh: 暗色纸张叠层与书本几何。
label.en: Layers of dark-toned paper and book-like geometry.

label.zh: 浅蓝灰、舒展条纹与轻柔织纹。
label.en: Pale blue-grey, open stripes and light woven texture.

label.zh: 土色底上的叶片、斑点和不规则小形状。
label.en: Leaves, speckles and irregular small shapes on earth tones.

prompt.zh: 想象几块现有布料放在一起，你更喜欢哪种视觉组合？
prompt.en: Imagine arranging pieces of fabric you already have. Which visual combination appeals?

label.zh: 深棕、暗绿和细密格纹。
label.en: Deep brown, dark green and fine checks.

label.zh: 接近的浅中性色与平整线条。
label.en: Similar pale neutrals with smooth lines.

label.zh: 苔绿、粗糙织纹与不完全相同的边缘。
label.en: Moss green, coarse weave and uneven edges.

label.zh: 暗底、反光质感和一条亮色分割。
label.en: A dark base, reflective texture and one bright division.

prompt.zh: 给一页文字安排背景，你更想要哪种氛围？
prompt.en: What atmosphere would you prefer behind a page of writing?

label.zh: 色差很小、边界清楚而留白充足。
label.en: Low colour contrast, clear boundaries and ample empty space.

label.zh: 轻淡蓝白与宽松、透气的布纹感。
label.en: Light blue-white with an open, airy fabric impression.

label.zh: 深色平面上有少量发光线条。
label.en: A dark plane with a few luminous lines.

label.zh: 暖浅色、细小植物纹样与柔软边缘。
label.en: Warm pale tones, small plant motifs and soft edges.

prompt.zh: 在一组图形描述里，你更愿意保留哪个主题？
prompt.en: Which theme would you retain from these graphic descriptions?

label.zh: 风感条纹、浅色木面与开阔空白。
label.en: Breezy stripes, pale wood and open space.

label.zh: 不规则植物细节和像旧纽扣的小圆形。
label.en: Irregular plant details and small old-button-like circles.

label.zh: 小花、格布与温暖的圆弧。
label.en: Small flowers, checked fabric and warm curves.

label.zh: 书页、深木色和正式对称边线。
label.en: Pages, dark wood tones and formal symmetrical borders.

prompt.zh: 如果只选一种明暗关系，你更喜欢？
prompt.en: If choosing only a light-and-dark relationship, which appeals?

label.zh: 阴影里的自然土色与细碎亮点。
label.en: Earth tones in shade with scattered light details.

label.zh: 暗面与局部高对比的人工亮光。
label.en: Dark surfaces with localised high-contrast artificial light.

label.zh: 低饱和深色与一块暖纸色。
label.en: Muted deep colours beside one warm paper tone.

label.zh: 大面积相近浅色与少量细深线。
label.en: Large similar pale areas with a few fine dark lines.

prompt.zh: 在自己已有的装饰材料中，你更想怎样组合一个小画面？
prompt.en: How would you arrange a small composition from materials you already have?

label.zh: 用暗纸和亮色细条做出界面般层次。
label.en: Use dark paper and bright strips for an interface-like layering.

label.zh: 把布纹、植物图案和暖色纸片放在一起。
label.en: Combine fabric texture, plant motifs and warm paper.

label.zh: 减少元素，只保留整齐的形状与空白。
label.en: Reduce the elements to orderly shapes and blank space.

label.zh: 用浅蓝、米白和宽条纹形成轻松层次。
label.en: Layer pale blue, cream and broad stripes in an open arrangement.

prompt.zh: 为一张风格灵感卡选开头，你更偏向哪组线索？
prompt.en: Which clues would you put first on a style-inspiration card?

label.zh: 暖色花纹、手作痕迹与圆润物件。
label.en: Warm floral patterns, handmade traces and rounded objects.

label.zh: 中性色、简明边线与少量元素。
label.en: Neutrals, simple outlines and a small number of elements.

label.zh: 苔色、斑驳纹理与不规则自然图形。
label.en: Moss colours, mottled textures and irregular natural shapes.

label.zh: 金属感、技术形状与暗底亮线。
label.en: Metallic impressions, technical shapes and bright lines on dark.

prompt.zh: 只比较图案密度和排列，你更喜欢？
prompt.en: Comparing only pattern density and arrangement, which appeals?

label.zh: 细格纹与正式、有层次的深色排列。
label.en: Fine checks and formal layered dark arrangements.

label.zh: 间距较开的浅色条纹。
label.en: Widely spaced stripes in pale colours.

label.zh: 密集网格中穿过一条发光轨迹。
label.en: A luminous track crossing a dense grid.

label.zh: 温和重复的小花和手工边线。
label.en: Gently repeated small flowers and handmade borders.

prompt.zh: 给一组物件拍自己的照片时，你更想突出哪种视觉关系？
prompt.en: When photographing your own objects, which visual relationship would you emphasise?

label.zh: 元素减少后留下的轮廓、间隔与浅色。
label.en: Outlines, spacing and pale colours after reducing elements.

label.zh: 旧物表面的细节、斑点与自然的不一致。
label.en: Details, speckles and natural irregularity on older objects.

label.zh: 柔和布纹、花样与温暖光感。
label.en: Soft fabric texture, floral patterns and a warm light impression.

label.zh: 纸页层次、深色背景与对称构图。
label.en: Layers of paper, a dark background and a symmetrical composition.

prompt.zh: 在一张想象中的房间局部图里，你更留意？
prompt.en: In a word-described corner of a room, what would draw your attention?

label.zh: 浅木色、蓝白布面与敞开的空间感。
label.en: Pale wood, blue-white fabric and an open spatial impression.

label.zh: 技术接口形状、暗色硬面和局部亮色。
label.en: Technical connector shapes, dark hard surfaces and a bright accent.

label.zh: 书脊、旧纸与深色框线。
label.en: Book spines, aged paper and dark frames.

label.zh: 几何形状、相近色与规整留白。
label.en: Geometric forms, close colours and orderly blank space.

prompt.zh: 如果把常见形状做成一小张拼贴，你更喜欢哪种变化？
prompt.en: For a small collage of ordinary shapes, which variation appeals?

label.zh: 让边缘不完全相同，加入自然斑点。
label.en: Keep edges uneven and add natural speckles.

label.zh: 加入细花样和柔和的织纹边缘。
label.en: Add small floral patterns and soft woven edges.

label.zh: 减少颜色，保留边界清楚的几何轮廓。
label.en: Reduce colours and keep clearly bounded geometric outlines.

label.zh: 把条纹拉疏，留出浅色与轻松间隔。
label.en: Space stripes out with pale colours and open intervals.

prompt.zh: 回看这些文字风格描述，你更想带走哪一种组合？
prompt.en: Looking back at these word-described styles, which combination would you keep?

label.zh: 暗色、人工亮光、机械与界面形状。
label.en: Dark colours, artificial light, mechanical and interface forms.

label.zh: 深色、旧纸、书本与正式线条。
label.en: Deep colours, aged paper, books and formal lines.

label.zh: 浅蓝米白、宽松布纹与开阔感。
label.en: Pale blue and cream, relaxed fabric and openness.

label.zh: 土色苔绿、旧物细节与自然不规则。
label.en: Earth and moss tones, old-object details and natural irregularity.
